name: Media cellular automata
doc: Cellular automata (Life-like rules and continuous Lenia) seeded from the input media's edges and brightness, with every living cell inheriting and evolving the picture's own colours alongside retro Bayer-dithered palette accents; beats snap colonies to the picture, bar-level spectral peaks shift rules, and onsets ignite cellular bursts.

in.doc: source media image or video whose colours live inside the cells

luma.doc: media brightness mask (e.g. core-media.luma) guiding cell fertility and seeding

edges.doc: media edge gradient (e.g. core-media.edges) seeding contours and advecting Lenia

palette.doc: accent palette for newborn flashes, afterglow and dithered colour modes

mode.doc: discrete Life-like rules, smooth embossed Lenia, or alternating every few bars

bars.doc: bars per regime in alternate mode

cells.doc: grid height in cells (width follows the screen aspect)

radius.doc: Lenia ring kernel radius in cells

dt.doc: Lenia integration step (loudness speeds it up)

edge_seed.doc: how strongly media edges emit new cells

luma_seed.doc: how strongly bright regions of the picture emit cells

media_pull.doc: how strongly media luma and edges steer growth and contour drift

colour.doc: cell colours: inherited picture RGB, picture + palette dither accents, or full palette

pal_mix.doc: palette blend on newborn cells, afterglow and dither accents

dither.doc: 4x4 Bayer ordered dither stylization on cell tones

gap.doc: dark pixel border between cells in Life mode

relief.doc: 3D emboss lighting depth in Lenia mode

under.doc: dim live picture underlay beneath the cells

flash.doc: onset newborn flash and pixel RGB pop

changelog.note: first version: media-seeded and video-coloured Life & Lenia cellular automata
